hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W, RK3506B, populated USB radio and onboard antenna

inputs.name: Luckfox Buildroot image with AIC8800DC modules and firmware
Diagnostic FIT with the original kernel, base DTB and external initramfs
inputs.revision: RAM-only root, microSD and SPI NAND controllers disabled by a DT overlay

scenario: Boot the diagnostic FIT into RAM. Select the onboard antenna with GPIO55. Load the two AIC8800DC modules from the matching vendor rootfs. Flush the BSS cache with wpa_cli and request a new scan. Associate through wpa_supplicant and obtain a DHCP lease.
expected: The onboard antenna receives scan results. The station completes WPA3-SAE association and obtains a DHCP lease.
observed: Linux ran from an initramfs. GPIO55 read back as an output at logic high. The fresh scan returned 19 BSS entries. The station completed WPA3-SAE association on 2.4 GHz. The DHCP client bound a lease.
limits: The test used the published Luckfox Linux kernel, modules and firmware in RAM. The driver and firmware set differ from those on the factory NAND sample.
The BSS count describes this scan. With driver log mask 3, dmesg showed no firmware build text. The vendor ethtool 6.6 reported driver usb, version 6.1.99 and an empty firmware-version field.
This result covers the Linux station. EmberBSD station creation and scan results are recorded separately.
